records.question: According to this section, where do the four feeding populations of humpback whales winter or calve?
ground_truth_chunks: Lawrence-Labrador-Newfoundland-Grand Bank; western Greenland; and Iceland.
No interchange of individuals between those feeding areas has yet been found but all four feeding populations winter or calve in the West **Indies.**

records.section_heading: ECOLOGY OF HUMPB WHALES IN AMERICAN
records.question: Between which dates were humpback whales observed in American Samoan waters, and when did peak concentrations occur?
records.ground_truth_answer: They were observed from June 26 to Nov. 15, with peak concentrations occurring from Sept. 15 to Oct. 1.
ground_truth_chunks: Humpbacks were observed inhabiting the near-shore waters of primarily 100 fathans or less fran June 26 to Nov. 15 with peak concentrations occurring fran Sept. 15 to Oct. 1.

records.section_heading: DEMOGRAPHICS OF HUMPBACK WHALES OFF SOUTHWEST MAUI, HAWAII
records.question: How many calves were observed in the study off southwest Maui from 1980 through 1983?
ground_truth_chunks: A total of 1218 hours of observation found, excluding single sightings, 1634 pods including 3215 animals of which 188 were calves.
